title: Range Sum Query 2D - Immutable
problemStatement: Given an N × M matrix and multiple queries, return the sum of all elements inside the rectangle defined by: Top-left corner (r1, c1) Bottom-right corner (r2, c2) Preprocess the matrix using a 2D prefix sum.
input: Integer N Integer M Matrix grid Integer Q Q rectangle queries
output: For each query, print the rectangle sum.
